title: Flat Allowances Carried by Benefit Category on a Rider Line
content:
Some benefit categories under the Optional Supplemental Benefit Riders carry a flat allowance rather than a percentage. The allowance a line carries is settled by what the line is.

## The rule

1. Where the line is a hearing aid, the allowance is the allowance for a hearing aid for one ear the rider held carries.
2. Where the line is a set of eyeglass frames, the allowance is the frame allowance the rider held carries.
3. Where the line is a pair of spectacle lenses, the allowance is the lens allowance the rider held carries.
4. Where the line is contact lenses worn instead of spectacles, the allowance is the contact lens allowance the rider held carries.
5. Otherwise the allowance is nothing, the benefit category carrying no flat allowance.

## The allowances each rider carries

| Rider | Hearing aid, one ear (USD) | Eyeglass frames (USD) | Spectacle lenses (USD) | Contact lenses (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgecrest Preventive Dental Rider | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Ridgecrest Vision Plus Rider | 0.00 | 175.00 | 150.00 | 160.00 |
| Ridgecrest Hearing Advantage Rider | 1250.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Ridgecrest Comprehensive Dental Rider | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Ridgecrest Premier Dental Rider | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Ridgecrest Dental Vision Hearing Bundle Rider | 1500.00 | 250.00 | 200.00 | 220.00 |

## Points of judgement

**Only four kinds of line carry a flat allowance.** A hearing aid, a set of eyeglass frames, a pair of spectacle lenses and contact lenses worn instead of spectacles. Every other benefit category — preventive dental care, basic and major restorative dental care, root canal treatment, gum treatment, oral surgery, dentures, implants, a dental examination, a routine eye examination and a hearing examination among them — carries no flat allowance.

**Contact lenses and spectacle lenses carry separate allowances.** Contact lenses worn instead of spectacles carry the contact lens allowance, which on the Ridgecrest Vision Plus Rider is 160.00 USD and on the Ridgecrest Dental Vision Hearing Bundle Rider 220.00 USD; a pair of spectacle lenses carries the lens allowance, 150.00 USD and 200.00 USD on those same two riders.

**A hearing aid is allowed for one ear at a time.** The allowance carried is the allowance for a hearing aid for one ear: 1250.00 USD on the Ridgecrest Hearing Advantage Rider and 1500.00 USD on the Ridgecrest Dental Vision Hearing Bundle Rider.
